caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with two main sections. The upper section consists of two tall glass-paneled doors, each divided into three sections by wooden muntins, with the uppermost panes arched. The lower section contains two opaque wooden doors, each with a rectangular frame and a prominent diamond-shaped accent in the center. The cabinet rests on short, bracket-shaped feet with a scalloped apron below the lower doors. The top of the cabinet features a decorative, intricately-shaped cornice with upward curves and points. The wood is colored in shades of light to medium brown, and the drawing is set against a plain, beige background. There are small, round keyholes on both the upper and lower doors, and the artist's name, "Grace Baker," is written in small text in the lower right corner.
title: China Closet
